what_it_shows: Ramp Accounting queue: dense card-transactions table (merchant, amount, cardholder, QuickBooks category, receipt indicator, Mark Ready/Sync actions) with left nav and inline bill-match prompt.
Same Ramp Accounting coding table showing a transaction with 'Matched to Bill #00-598' chip and green Ready state, plus Sync (2) call-to-action.

Ramp transaction detail in review: 'Awaiting review from...' banner, Requirements complete badge, Approvals 0-of-2 approver chain, Reject dropdown (Request changes / Request repay) and Approve button with keyboard shortcuts.

Ramp Policy Agent verdicts on a transaction: green 'Transaction complete — Ramp found no issues and suggested it be approved' card with reason bullets (receipt auto-verified), plus '971 transactions were automatically approved by agent' summary row.
Ramp 'Match transaction to bill' side panel: transaction summary, searchable NetSuite bills table with checkboxes, 'Selected bill matches expense amount' validation, Match & mark ready button.
Ramp receipt verification popover on a matched receipt: 'Auto-verified' state with verified amount/date/merchant checklist and 'Report incorrect receipt verification' action.
Ramp conditional coding rule builder: 'If Ramp Location is Miami → Display GL accounts...' / 'If no conditions are met → Display all options for NetSuite Category' branching editor.
Ramp Policy settings page (Spend request approvals, Expense requirements, Expense approvals, employee policy signatures) with docked AI policy-agent chat sidebar answering a policy question.

Ramp Policy Agent analytics: in-policy spend KPIs with trend charts, agent-vs-reviewer outcome table, department out-of-policy insights, and a transaction activity timeline including 'Automatically matched a receipt from Gmail Integration'.

Ramp budget dashboard ('2026 Budget'): total/spent/committed KPIs, donut and monthly budget-vs-actuals bars, per-department budget utilization table with overage highlighting (marketing asset rendered from real product UI).
Ramp Bill Pay 'New Bill' screen: uploaded invoice PDF on the left, AI-extracted vendor/invoice #/dates fields on the right with QuickBooks sync and Review button (demo browser frame).
Ramp Bill Pay Bills list: Overview / Drafts / For approval / For payment tabs with accounting-class filter pill and multi-select exclude filter dropdown.
